scope: reuse 6387 frozen sample/prediction registry and archived evidence, no Test recalculation or new model inference
primary_concern: any_fragment_match OR cross_source_label_disagreement, inherited all-population operational flag; not label error
strict_reliable_requirement: original binary labeling rule/endpoint traceable AND exact tested molecular/chemical identity and experimental evidence aligned; cannot substitute current keyword, absence of flag or model agreement
manual_review_use: descriptive sidecar only; 36-case ascertainment biased toward errors; not added to uniform primary marker or used as reliability weight
direct_effect_candidates: archived 4 records support specific effects, not original toxicity endpoint/label gold
physical_strata: original label 0/1 crossed with Cys<4/Cys>=4, retain all four
statistical_scope: historical exploratory association, not newly held-out hypothesis confirmation or causal shortcut proof
conditional_model: separate by original label/version: error ~ difficult_Cys_stratum + fragment + cross_source_conflict(if variable) + length spline(df=3) + heldout fold + unresolved_identity(if variable); sequence-group cluster sandwich CI; report coverage, do not claim source or family adjusted
family_source_constraint: audit full provenance and within-group overlap; curated/name annotations are sparse/error-ascertained, no missing-family imputation as confirmed adjustment
training_readiness: no numerical reliability weighting until evidential coverage adequate and training/evaluation isolated
